hero.subtitle: Create tasks, collaborate with your team, and stay on top of deadlines — all in one clean, intuitive app.

features.subtitle: Built for teams who want to get things done — not spend hours configuring yet another tool.
features.groupTasksDesc: Create groups, invite members, and manage tasks together. Assign tasks, track progress, and keep everyone aligned.
features.remindersDesc: Notifications that actually work. Set custom reminders and never miss a deadline again.
features.templatesDesc: Save time with reusable task templates. Create once, use everywhere — perfect for recurring workflows.
features.calendarDesc: See your tasks on a calendar. Plan your day, week, or month with a clear visual overview.
features.widgetDesc: Quick access to your tasks right from your home screen. Check and complete tasks without opening the app.
features.multilangDesc: Available in Turkish, English, German, Spanish, Arabic, and Chinese. Use Taskative in your language.
features.nlpDesc: Type tasks in plain language — "call Mom tomorrow at 5pm" — and Taskative sets the date, time, and repeat for you. Works in Turkish, English, German, and Spanish.
features.recurringDesc: Set a task to repeat daily, weekly, or monthly. Create it once and it comes back on schedule — no copy-paste.
features.checklistsDesc: Break a task into steps and watch the progress bar fill. Everyone sees what is done and what is left.
features.commentsDesc: Instructions, updates, and questions live inside the task — not scattered across group chats.
features.offlineDesc: Create and complete tasks with no signal. Everything syncs the moment you are back online.
features.securityDesc: Play Integrity app verification on every request. No ads, no data selling — your team’s tasks stay your team’s.

sectors.subtitle: Wherever the same work repeats every shift, Taskative replaces sticky notes, spreadsheets, and group chats.
sectors.retailDesc: Opening and closing checklists per shift. See at a glance who finished the routine and who did not.
sectors.cleaningDesc: One recurring routine per site or floor. Crews tick off steps on their phone, supervisors watch progress live.
sectors.maintenanceDesc: Work orders with the full context inside the task. Reminders fire before the SLA runs out, not after.
sectors.agencyDesc: A group per client, deadlines on a shared timeline. Nobody has to ask "where are we on this?" again.
sectors.logisticsDesc: Field teams work without signal and sync on the way back. Today’s stops sit on the home screen widget.
sectors.householdDesc: Shared chores and group assignments with reminders that actually arrive. Free for small teams.
sectors.footnote: Same app, same price — no per-industry upsell, no sales call required.

pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need more. No hidden fees, no surprises.

platforms.title: Taskative,
platforms.subtitle: Your tasks sync in real time across mobile, web, and browser extension. Pick your favorite and get started.
platforms.mobileDesc: Native Android with widgets, reliable reminders, and offline support. Capture on the go, check off from home screen.
platforms.webDesc: Full dashboard in any browser — calendar, timeline, and reports. Smart Import turns pasted notes into tasks; export to CSV or JSON any time. No installation required.
platforms.extensionDesc: Right-click any text on any webpage to turn it into a task. Perfect for Gmail, Notion, articles, research.

cta.title: Ready to get organized?
cta.subtitle: Join teams managing their tasks with Taskative. Start free — no credit card required.
